resale_co.name: Residential Certificate of Zoning Compliance (CZC), previously called Certificate of Occupancy
resale_co.issued_by: Borough of Rutherford Construction Official (Building and Zoning Department)
resale_co.lead_time: Inspections are scheduled after the form is received; the certificate is issued no sooner than 48 hours after all inspections pass (the form says 24 hours). The CZC inspection is not scheduled until all open permits are closed.
requirements: Open or outstanding permits must have final inspections and be closed before the CZC inspection is scheduled
Street numbers at least 3 inches high with a 1/2 inch stroke, visible from the street
Garages, fences, sheds and walls in good repair; sidewalks, stairs, driveways and walkways free of hazards
Attached garage fire rating maintained, holes patched, and a listed self-closing device on any door into the house
No sump pump may discharge to the sewer
Pressure relief discharge pipe on heating units and water heaters, full size, ending no more than 6 inches off the floor
Clearances around fuel burning appliances; roof sound and leaders discharging away from the foundation
Smoke and carbon monoxide alarms (checked during the CZC inspection; see fire certificate)
Transfer of Title Certificate instead of a CZC only if the home will not be occupied after purchase, with a letter from the buyer's attorney

fees.label: Residential Certificate of Zoning Compliance (1 or 2 family, condo, co-op)
fees.quote: For a residential Certificate of Zoning Compliance certificate (previously Certificate of Occupancy) please fill out the following form and submit with $100 payment

fees.label: Certificate of occupancy for resale, R-2, R-3, R-4 and R-5 uses (Code Section 22-6A(1)(a))
fees.quote: For R-2, R-3, R-4 and R-5 uses: $100 per dwelling unit.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Residential Certificate of Zoning Compliance Application and Requirements (Includes Transfer of Title) and submit it with a $100 check (or exact cash) payable to the Borough of Rutherford at the Building and Zoning office, Borough Hall, 176 Park Avenue, Main Level. Inspections are then scheduled; call 201-460-3042 to schedule the zoning inspection and 201-460-3010 about open permits. Choose pick-up or email delivery of the certificate on the form.

evidence.quote: A certificate of zoning compliance shall be applied for and obtained prior to the use or occupancy of the whole or any part of any building:
Once all inspections have passed the Certificate will be issued no sooner than 48 hours after sign-off.
Residents who are selling their home should call the office ahead of time at 201-460-3010 to ensure this is taken care of.
Transfer of Title Certificate: Only issued if home will not be occupied after purchase (i.e. the owner will undergo major renovations).

resale_co.notes: Code Section 131-44 (amended 12-13-2021 by Ord. No. 3587-21, read through the ecode360 print view) requires a certificate of zoning compliance before occupancy of a building undergoing a change in ownership. Sections 131-45 and 131-46 allow a conditional CZC (violations fixed within about 30 days, buyer countersigns) or a deferral (no occupancy until repairs) for 1 and 2 family homes being transferred. Section 22-6A also lists a $125 'certificate of continued occupancy (i.e., V.A., FHA, etc.)'. The form's footer email is misspelled (zoning@rutherordboronj.com); the department page shows zoning@rutherfordboronj.com. 3-family and larger homes also need a Bureau of Fire Safety inspection (201-460-3011). Rental-only items (lead-safe certification for pre-1978 rentals through LEW Environmental, short-term rental prohibition) are not resale requirements.

requirements: Smoke alarms on each level and outside/in the vicinity of each separate sleeping area, per NFPA 72 (interconnection not required)
Ten-year sealed battery smoke alarms listed to ANSI/UL 217; hardwired alarms from original construction or rehabilitation may not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarms within 10 feet of the sleeping areas in homes with a fuel burning device or attached garage (battery, hardwired or plug-in, UL 2034, NFPA 720)
Ten-year sealed battery combination smoke and CO alarms are permitted

authorities.name: Borough of Rutherford Building and Zoning Department (smoke/CO checked during the Certificate of Zoning Compliance inspection); fire code enforcing agency: Rutherford Bureau of Fire Safety
authorities.lead_time: Same as the Certificate of Zoning Compliance: certificate issued no sooner than 48 hours after all inspections pass.
authorities.how_to_apply: No separate smoke/CO application was found for 1 and 2 family homes. The smoke and carbon monoxide alarm requirements are printed in the Residential Certificate of Zoning Compliance packet, and the inspector's sheet has an SD/CO line, so the check appears to be part of the $100 CZC. 3-family and larger homes are inspected by the Bureau of Fire Safety (201-460-3011).

evidence.quote: Please note that all 3-family and above are subject to an inspection by the Bureau of Fire Safety.
Editor's Note: Former §34A-13, Smoke and carbon monoxide detectors, as amended, was repealed 10-26-2020 by Ord. No. 3536-20.
LEAID: 0256-001 Enf Auth. Municipal Fire Official Paul T Dansbach Phone (201) 460-3011

fire_cert.notes: Rutherford's fire code enforcing agency is the municipal Bureau of Fire Safety (LEA type M), but its page says its main job is commercial and multi-family buildings. The local smoke/CO detector section of the fire code (former Section 34A-13) was repealed in 2020. For 1 and 2 family resales the only smoke/CO material found is inside the Building and Zoning Department's CZC packet, and the inspector's sheet has an SD/CO line, so the smoke/CO check looks bundled into the $100 CZC. No separate smoke/CO fee was found. The Borough's packet does not list a fire extinguisher, consistent with P.L.2025, c.19. Confirm by phone who signs the smoke/CO certificate (Building and Zoning or the Bureau of Fire Safety) and whether a separate fee applies.

other_items.label: Open permits
other_items.detail: All open or outstanding construction permits must be finaled and closed before the CZC inspection is scheduled; sellers are asked to call 201-460-3010 ahead of time.

other_items.label: Sump pump not to sewer
other_items.detail: The CZC checklist says no sump pump may discharge to the sewer.

other_items.label: Sidewalks, stairs, driveways and walkways
other_items.detail: Checked during the CZC inspection; must be in good repair and free of tripping hazards.

open_questions: Is the smoke/CO certificate for a 1 or 2 family resale issued by the Building and Zoning office as part of the CZC, or separately by the Bureau of Fire Safety, and is there a separate fee?
Is the certificate issued 24 hours (form) or 48 hours (web page) after a passed inspection, and how far ahead are inspections booked?
How long is the CZC valid before closing?
